typed_core.name: transcript_type
typed_core.why: disambiguator — Return Transcript vs Account Transcript vs Record of Account

typed_core.name: tax_form_number
typed_core.why: disambiguator — 1120 (C-corp) vs 1120-S (S-corp, pass-through); the distinction changes how owner income is read
typed_core.prompt_hint: Distinguish 1120 (C-corp) from 1120-S (S-corp) — the S-corp is a pass-through and owner income is read differently (K-1 + W-2), while the C-corp retains earnings

typed_core.name: request_or_processing_date

typed_core.name: corporation_legal_name

typed_core.name: accounting_method
typed_core.why: disambiguator — cash vs accrual for the income figures

typed_core.name: consolidated_return_indicator

typed_core.prompt_hint: A consolidated return flag means the numbers span multiple entities

encoding_variations: 1120 vs 1120-S — a C-corp (1120) is a separate taxpayer; an S-corp (1120-S) is pass-through and the owner's income flows via K-1. tax_form_number is the critical disambiguator for how owner income is computed
consolidated return — aggregates parent + subsidiaries; a single borrower-owned entity's figures may be buried; capture the indicator
officer compensation — Line 12 / Form 1125-E; the owner's salary is here, separate from dividends/distributions
taxable income before NOL — distinct from final taxable income; both matter for add-back analysis
